decisions.reason: The article requires a regulator-and-motor assembly and may require a door module, while the unscoped claim is only a window motor and has no confirmed catalog application.
PCV replacement is only one conditional step after sludge and oil-pressure diagnosis, and the unscoped PC272 claim was not confirmed by the catalog.
The power-steering-pump claim lacks engine/application scope and the catalog did not confirm Cardone 21-5410 for the frozen article.
The compressor is a prescribed repair, but the unscoped Denso 471-1293 claim was not confirmed for the frozen Crossfire application.
The article spans multiple 2.2L, 2.5L, and 3.0L applications, while the unscoped Delphi TS10019 claim was not confirmed for any reviewed slice.
The unscoped Cardone window-motor claim has no side/body/application evidence and the catalog did not confirm it for the frozen article.
The article requires TPMS sensor replacement and programming; a Bosch vehicle battery is the wrong repair role.
The valve-cover gasket is diagnosis-dependent and the unscoped MAHLE VS50248 claim was not confirmed by the catalog for the frozen Prowler application.
The condenser is directly prescribed, but the unscoped Denso 477-0817 claim was not confirmed by the current all-year catalog run.
Radiator-cap replacement is one branch of a multi-cause overheating diagnosis, and Gates 31518 was not catalog-confirmed for the frozen vehicle scope.
The article specifies generation-specific Gates complete kits, while Continental CK265LK2 is unscoped and was not confirmed for either reviewed engine/year branch.
The repair depends on the failed suspension component and side, while the unscoped MOOG bushing kit was not confirmed for the frozen application.
The regulator assembly lacks side/body/application scope and Aisin RPACH-084 was not confirmed by the catalog for the frozen Sebring article.
The article prescribes a complete aluminum oil-filter housing/oil-cooler assembly, while MAHLE GS33753 is only a gasket set and is the wrong repair role.
